title: Jonah and the Ledger
author: Orsen Blackwood
blurb: Vesper Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
